intro:
If you're looking at Nightwatch for AI visibility, the sticker price can be misleading. The number you see first — around $32/month on annual billing — is for traditional keyword rank tracking, which Nightwatch does very well. AI visibility tracking is priced and metered separately, and that's where the cost climbs.

This page breaks down what AI tracking actually costs on Nightwatch, why the advertised entry price understates it, and when paying for it is genuinely worth it versus when a free, instant check is all you need.

sections.heading: What you're actually paying for
sections.body:
Nightwatch is, at its core, a 13-year-old SEO rank tracker — and a strong one. The ~$32/month entry price (billed annually) buys keyword rank tracking, typically around 250 keywords, with unlimited user seats and white-label reports. That's a fair deal for rank tracking alone.

AI visibility — tracking whether ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity and Google's AI Overviews mention or recommend your brand — is a different, newer capability. Nightwatch meters it by **prompts**: each prompt is a buyer question it runs repeatedly across AI engines to measure your share of voice and citations. Most independent reviews through early 2026 describe AI tracking as a paid beta add-on starting at **+$99/month for 100 prompts**, scaling through tiers up to roughly **$495/month for 500 prompts**.

One note on accuracy: Nightwatch has been actively repackaging this. Its live pricing page now bundles AI prompts into tiered plans (with prompt caps per tier) rather than a flat add-on. Pricing in this space changes fast, so check the current nightwatch.io/pricing before you buy — but either way, AI visibility is metered and adds real cost.

sections.heading: Why the real price is higher than advertised
sections.body:
The gap between the headline and the real number is the whole concern here. The ~$32/month figure is rank tracking. To actually track AI visibility under the add-on model that reviewers documented, you needed the base plan **plus** the AI module — a real-world minimum that several reviewers pegged at roughly **$131+/month**.

That means the AI piece alone (~$99/mo) costs about **2.5x the base plan**. So the person who comes to Nightwatch specifically for AI visibility — arguably the fastest-growing reason anyone shops for this tool — pays well above the price the marketing leads with.

This isn't a gotcha unique to Nightwatch; metered AI querying is genuinely expensive to run, and Nightwatch is transparent that prompts are the unit of cost. But it does mean you should price the thing you actually want. If AI visibility is your goal, budget for the AI tier, not the $32 line item. And if you're on a bundled plan instead, watch the **prompt cap** — a broad prompt library across several engines burns through 50–150 prompts quickly.

sections.heading: When Nightwatch AI tracking is worth it
sections.body:
Pay for Nightwatch AI tracking if most of these are true: you already run serious, ongoing SEO; you want AI mentions and traditional rankings side by side in one historical dashboard; you have a defined set of buyer prompts you'll monitor over time; and you have someone comfortable configuring keyword/prompt setups and reading share-of-voice and citation reports.

In that scenario it's a reasonable buy. Nightwatch's strength is depth and history — 13 years of ranking data, granular local and segment tracking, white-label client reporting, unlimited seats. For an SEO team or agency, folding AI visibility into that existing workflow is convenient and the per-prompt cost is defensible.

Where it's a poor fit: you're a non-specialist who just wants to know, right now, whether AI engines recommend your brand. Nightwatch is a platform you configure and learn, on a paid plan, with the AI piece metered on top. That's a lot of setup and spend to answer one question — especially before you know whether you even have a visibility problem worth tracking continuously.

AI visibility tracking is metered by prompts: most reviews through early 2026 describe it as an add-on starting at +$99/month for 100 prompts and scaling to about $495/month for 500 prompts. That puts the real minimum to track AI near $131+/month. Nightwatch has begun bundling AI prompts into tiered plans, so confirm the current price on nightwatch.io/pricing.
